args.final_thought:
I need to finalize with a trace. Based on my analysis, the vulnerability is the `isolate_level--` in the PDI handling that can decrement below zero when `valid_isolate_count > 0` but the stack is empty (due to isolates counted but not pushed when `over_pushed > 0`). Let me provide the trace based on the evidence I've gathered.

  {"step": 2, "file": "lib/fribidi-bidi.c", "function": "fribidi_get_par_embedding_levels_ex", "line": 773, "var": "isolate_level", "code": "if (isolate_level < FRIBIDI_BIDI_MAX_EXPLICIT_LEVEL-1) isolate_level++;", "note": "Each isolate (RLI/LRI) increments isolate_level, capped at 124; valid_isolate_count tracks open isolates."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "lib/fribidi-bidi.c", "function": "fribidi_get_par_embedding_levels_ex", "line": 774, "var": "valid_isolate_count", "code": "if (new_level <= FRIBIDI_BIDI_MAX_EXPLICIT_LEVEL) { valid_isolate_count++; PUSH_STATUS; }", "note": "A valid isolate increments valid_isolate_count, but PUSH_STATUS may skip pushing to the stack when over_pushed > 0, leaving the isolate counted but not on the stack."},

  {"step": 5, "file": "lib/fribidi-bidi.c", "function": "fribidi_get_par_embedding_levels_ex", "line": 711, "var": "isolate_level", "code": "isolate_level--;", "note": "When isolate_level is already 0 and valid_isolate_count > 0 (due to the un-pushed isolate), this decrement makes isolate_level negative (-1), the root-cause underflow."},
